comment: * Builder for {@link MediaRouteDescriptor media route descriptors}.

methods.name: public Builder setId(String id)
methods.comment:
* Sets the unique id of the route. *

* The route id associated with a route descriptor functions as a stable * identifier for the route and must be unique among all routes offered * by the provider. *

methods.name: public Builder addGroupMemberId(String groupMemberId)
methods.comment:
* Adds a group member id of the route. *

* A route descriptor that has one or more group member route ids * represents a route group. A member route may belong to another group. *

* @hide

methods.name: public Builder addGroupMemberIds(Collection<String> groupMemberIds)
methods.comment:
* Adds a list of group member ids of the route. *

* A route descriptor that has one or more group member route ids * represents a route group. A member route may belong to another group. *

* @hide

methods.name: public Builder setName(String name)
methods.comment:
* Sets the user-visible name of the route. *

* The route name identifies the destination represented by the route. * It may be a user-supplied name, an alias, or device serial number. *

methods.name: public Builder setDescription(String description)
methods.comment:
* Sets the user-visible description of the route. *

* The route description describes the kind of destination represented by the route. * It may be a user-supplied string, a model number or brand of device. *

methods.name: public Builder setIconUri(Uri iconUri)
methods.comment:
* Sets the URI of the icon representing this route. *

* This icon will be used in picker UIs if available. *

* The URI must be one of the following formats: *

    *
  • content ({@link android.content.ContentResolver#SCHEME_CONTENT})
    • *
  • android.resource ({@link android.content.ContentResolver#SCHEME_ANDROID_RESOURCE}) *
    • *
  • file ({@link android.content.ContentResolver#SCHEME_FILE})
    • *
*

methods.name: public Builder setEnabled(boolean enabled)
methods.comment:
* Sets whether the route is enabled. *

* Disabled routes represent routes that a route provider knows about, such as paired * Wifi Display receivers, but that are not currently available for use. *

methods.name: public Builder setConnecting(boolean connecting)
methods.comment:
* Sets whether the route is in the process of connecting and is not yet
         * ready for use.
         * @deprecated Use {@link #setConnectionState} instead.

methods.name: public Builder setConnectionState(int connectionState)
methods.comment:
* Sets the route's connection state.
         *
         * @param connectionState The connection state of the route:
         * {@link MediaRouter.RouteInfo#CONNECTION_STATE_DISCONNECTED},
         * {@link MediaRouter.RouteInfo#CONNECTION_STATE_CONNECTING}, or
         * {@link MediaRouter.RouteInfo#CONNECTION_STATE_CONNECTED}.

methods.name: public Builder setCanDisconnect(boolean canDisconnect)
methods.comment: * Sets whether the route can be disconnected without stopping playback.

methods.name: public Builder setSettingsActivity(IntentSender is)
methods.comment:
* Sets an intent sender for launching the settings activity for this
         * route.

methods.name: public Builder addControlFilter(IntentFilter filter)
methods.comment: * Adds a {@link MediaControlIntent media control intent} filter for the route.

methods.name: public Builder addControlFilters(Collection<IntentFilter> filters)
methods.comment: * Adds a list of {@link MediaControlIntent media control intent} filters for the route.

methods.name: public Builder setPlaybackType(int playbackType)
methods.comment:
* Sets the route's playback type.
         *
         * @param playbackType The playback type of the route:
         * {@link MediaRouter.RouteInfo#PLAYBACK_TYPE_LOCAL} or
         * {@link MediaRouter.RouteInfo#PLAYBACK_TYPE_REMOTE}.

methods.name: public Builder setPlaybackStream(int playbackStream)
methods.comment: * Sets the route's playback stream.

methods.name: public Builder setDeviceType(int deviceType)
methods.comment:
* Sets the route's receiver device type.
         *
         * @param deviceType The receive device type of the route:
         * {@link MediaRouter.RouteInfo#DEVICE_TYPE_TV} or
         * {@link MediaRouter.RouteInfo#DEVICE_TYPE_SPEAKER}.

methods.name: public Builder setVolume(int volume)
methods.comment: * Sets the route's current volume, or 0 if unknown.

methods.name: public Builder setVolumeMax(int volumeMax)
methods.comment: * Sets the route's maximum volume, or 0 if unknown.

methods.name: public Builder setVolumeHandling(int volumeHandling)
methods.comment:
* Sets the route's volume handling.
         *
         * @param volumeHandling how volume is handled on the route:
         * {@link MediaRouter.RouteInfo#PLAYBACK_VOLUME_FIXED} or
         * {@link MediaRouter.RouteInfo#PLAYBACK_VOLUME_VARIABLE}.

methods.name: public Builder setPresentationDisplayId(int presentationDisplayId)
methods.comment: * Sets the route's presentation display id, or -1 if none.

methods.name: public Builder setExtras(Bundle extras)
methods.comment:
* Sets a bundle of extras for this route descriptor.
         * The extras will be ignored by the media router but they may be used
         * by applications.

methods.name: public MediaRouteDescriptor build()
methods.comment: * Builds the {@link MediaRouteDescriptor media route descriptor}.
